description: Health Systems Consult Limited publishes a health-facility assessment undertaken to support the Lagos State Health Scheme. The assessment was prepared for the Lagos State Health Management Agency to inform strategic purchasing and the scheme’s rollout. Figshare’s public article API confirms the named resource, an XLSX workbook and CC BY 4.0 rights, allowing free reuse despite the HTML page returning HTTP 202 in script requests. The metadata does not establish an exact survey period, facility count or complete variable list. The workbook can support healthcare-service planning simulations after those definitions are checked. Assessment coverage and reporting quality may limit inference about unassessed facilities or unmet demand. No directly related catalogue entry was identified.
